title: Migrate skull3 to one stroke_sculpt pass and retest two large strokes summed
user-messages:
> What we give up with one pass:

if you need two passes I think it would be better to save off the model and write a new dsl, since the chain is too hard to reason about
description: Split from MESH-86 part (c). MESH-86 made stroke_sculpt one pass on its base (strokes held on the base by a sidecar, summed, a stroke_sculpt input refused) and migrated stroke_sculpt_head, stroke_sculpt_sphere and stroke_crease_sphere. dsl/skull3/skull.dsl (MESH-79) chains ten stroke_sculpt layers and is not on master, so it could not be migrated there. Once MESH-79 lands: convert its SVGs with sculpt-migrate (they carry data-strength), merge the ten layer SVGs into one SVG with a <g id> per layer (they share one camera: centre -0.004 0.032 -0.022, distance 4.397), give the three crease=0.0 layers a per-stroke way to say no crease (the node's crease port is per pass), run ixdar-cli sculpt-sync, and capture before/after with strokes overlaid on all 8 cells (teeth ticks and bite line lining up). Strokes drawn on surface an earlier layer had pushed (profile, face_turn) now land on the base; large moves may need the sculpt saved as a new base and a second DSL. Then retest MESH-81 (two large strokes pit the far side) on the summed pass: MESH-86 removed one interference (the refinement gap rule now counts only opposite-sign neighbours), and MESH-78's crossing limiter belongs on the summed pass's final step.
definition-of-done: dsl/skull3/skull.dsl is one stroke_sculpt pass with a sidecar and loads; before/after multiview with strokes overlaid on all 8 cells under tmp/; load time and vertex count before/after recorded; MESH-81 retested on it with the result in changes-made.
testing-plan: Load dsl/skull3/skull.dsl before and after; multiview with sculpt-sync's strokes overlaid; mesh-topology inward faces; stroke-report per layer.
changes-made: Closed without work: run 3 (MESH-79) was archived on 2026-11-01 (tag archive/mesh-79) instead of landing, so there is no skull3 layered sculpt on master to migrate to one-pass.
